authentication: peer UID equals service UID; 0700 directory and 0600 socket
common_api: /api/v1 resources: same dispatcher, Principal::LocalUid, CSRF exemption only for this transport

input.absolute_path: exact absolute path of a registered project folder or of one of its declared member folders

output.items: array of {request_id, command_epoch, state, project_id, target: {type, id}, operation: create|replace|delete, before_version, after_version, current_version}; versions are null when absent

input.current_version: Version of the reviewed current source, or null for an absent source

relocate.new_absolute_path: exact absolute path of already moved/copied project

add_member.relative_path: existing folder below the project folder, '/'-separated, in its listed spelling

notes: Plan is no destructive action. Commit rechecks preconditions.
A member folder selects its project only by its own exact path. Resolution never walks to a parent or child folder. See ADR-080.
Maintenance API is internal, not offered to unauthenticated loopback or remote browser.
Schema variants must be implemented as strict tagged unions, not unrestricted maps.
Built-in backup/restore archives and source-file migrations are deferred by the owner on 2026-09-05.
Recovery review keeps the current source and rejects one needs_review command as RECOVERY_ABANDONED; it never writes a source file. See ADR-067.

profile_selection.value: canonical UUIDv4; omitted selects the default Owner
profile_selection.scope: Every common API and local workspace operation uses the selected profile, including hello epoch, project resolution, roots, registration and maintenance. Pairing remains global. Any trusted local caller may select any profile.
profile_selection.global_user_creation: POST /api/v1/users and PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_id} use the default profile header and command epoch. Command status and retries retain that default selection. Rename additionally requires the observed users registry version in If-Match.
